requirement:
`habeas mdbook` MUST NOT generate per-test coverage subchapters or captured-source
pages under the execution-coverage chapter of
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index`. File-notes pages supporting coverage
gap explanations under {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes`
MUST remain available.
rationale: The subject has two obligations. The first is that `habeas mdbook` MUST NOT generate per-test coverage subchapters or captured-source pages under the execution-coverage chapter. The second is that file-notes pages MUST remain available. The marked tests cover both. **No per-test or captured-source pages** - `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[gaps_omit_test_data_and_preserve_saved_profiles_and_sources]` records two tests and adds a child process. After `populate`, it loops over every chapter in the book, which includes nested subchapters. - It asserts that no chapter content contains "Test process coverage", "Captured source", "habeas-coverage-test", "Test runs and provenance", "binary / one", "binary / two", or the captured source text. - It asserts that no chapter name starts with "binary /". - It asserts that no chapter path ends in "-source.md". - It asserts that every chapter is either "Coverage gaps" or a "File notes:" page. - A per-test subchapter or a captured-source page would break at least one of these assertions. - It also asserts that the saved attempt and run data and the profile files are unchanged. - `gaps_union_process_locations_and_omit_per_test_reports` asserts that every chapter after the index has a name starting with "File notes:". It also asserts that the rendered index lacks "habeas-coverage-test", "Test runs and provenance", and "binary / one". - `generated_reports_inherit_the_requirements_index_hierarchy` is also marked for this requirement. It iterates over `coverage.sub_items` and checks each page's parent names, section numbers, and link back to `../coverage.html`. Those pages are the notes pages. **File-notes pages remain available** - `gaps_union_process_locations_and_omit_per_test_reports` computes the notes path for `code.rs`. It asserts that the file card links to that path. It then finds the chapter at that path and asserts that its content contains "File: code.rs". - The same test shows that a non-executable file gets no card, so the notes pages are produced for the listed files. - `gaps_omit_test_data_and_preserve_saved_profiles_and_sources` asserts that no "File notes: passing.rs" page exists for a fully passing file, and that the remaining chapters are "Coverage gaps" or "File notes:" pages. **Not assessed here** - Whether each notes page identifies its workspace-relative path belongs to `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.notes`. That is a cited requirement and is not reassessed. - `filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source` carries the reference but adds no extra assertions for this subject. The negative obligation is checked on name, path, and content across all chapters. The positive obligation is checked by an existence and content assertion. I found no gap.
